llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and low-risk: it is instruction-only (no code, no downloads, no credentials). Before installing, consider: (1) The skill owner and homepage are not provided — if you require publisher verification, treat it as unverified. (2) Do not include secrets or private data when asking the skill to rewrite or generate prompts, since those prompts are returned as text. (3) Because autonomous invocation is allowed by default, review agent-level policies if you do not want the skill invoked without explicit user action. (4) Test the skill with non-sensitive example prompts first to confirm behavior. Overall it is coherent with its stated purpose, but avoid supplying confidential inputs to any third-party skill.
